spec.headline: GTA 6 SOLD AN EST. |19M COPIES|
spec.topic: GTA 6 day 2: Sensor Tower estimates 19.05M copies / $1.84B by the morning of 19 Nov (incl. pre-orders, digital); GTA V 2013 first 24 h: 11.21M units / $815.7M (Take-Two, Guinness). Take-Two has not confirmed. Sources: Fox 5 NY (19 Nov), Geeks + Gamers (19 Nov, citing Sensor Tower/Forbes)
